activation_extraction.patch_positions: last token of each of the ten scenario rows A--J
activation_extraction.states: embedding plus every transformer-block output, float16

behavior_estimands.accuracy: original-prompt response MAE(prior) minus response MAE(matched), equally averaged over k=0 and k=8
behavior_estimands.decode: five draws, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95, strict forecast-array grammar
behavior_estimands.transplant: projection of predicted response(transplant)-predicted response(original) onto donor-response minus original-response, normalized by squared donor displacement

patching_estimand.same_episode_specificity: mean aligned same-episode effect minus mean aligned reciprocal wrong-episode effect
patching_estimand.selection: development-selected three-state-layer window centered on probe layer
patching_estimand.test_inputs: sealed original prompts at k=0 and k=8

replication_rule: submit the complete Qwen3-4B three-seed protocol only if every Qwen3-8B gate passes; 14B remains ineligible until its separate behavioral matched-training advantage is confirmed

representation_estimand.cross_validation: four development folds grouped by reciprocal donor pair
representation_estimand.readout: one ridge decoder pooled symmetrically across matched and prior arm means
representation_estimand.selection: development-only alpha and layer; transformer-state layers 1--35 eligible
representation_estimand.transplant_effect: projection of decoded transplant-minus-original kernel onto donor-minus-original kernel, divided by donor displacement squared

secondary_reference: untrained base, extracted only for seed 42 and never gated
success_gate: frozen-subset matched accuracy advantage has CI lower bound > 0 and all seeds positive
common-readout within-cell kernel advantage has CI lower bound > 0 and all seeds positive
matched-state reference-transplant tracking has CI lower bound > 0
matched-to-prior patch improvement has CI lower bound > 0
prior-to-matched patch harm has CI lower bound > 0
same-episode aligned patch effect exceeds wrong-episode effect with CI lower bound > 0
all required directional effects are positive in seeds 42, 43, and 44
strict parse rate is at least 0.99 and self-patch forecast fidelity is at least 0.99

uncertainty.method: hierarchical paired bootstrap: training seed first, episode second
